column1: # Time limits of single tests in the full gate (scripts/gate_test.py --limits, ADR 0740). A test named here has the limit of its
# row in seconds; every other test keeps the limit of gate_test.py (3600 s in the gate). A new row needs a registration that
# gives the measured times it rests on. scripts/gate_limit_check.py reads the same table: a test must take at most half its limit.
